newsitem.title: USA: Salix Holdings files for public offering.
newsitem.headline: Salix Holdings files for public offering.

text.p: Salix Holdings said Monday that it has filed registration documents for the issuance of three million common shares with both Canadian and U.S. securities regulators.
The shares are expected to be offered to the public in late September or early October 1997, the company said.

Salix, a drug maker, said in a statement that it filed a preliminary prospectus with securities regulators in all Canadian provinces as well as a registration statement on form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

The company said the underwriters, led by Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion Inc and Yorktown Securities Inc, will have the option to purchase an additional 450,000 common shares to cover any overallotments.
Salix said that after the shares are issued it will have approximately 10,118,173 common shares outstanding.
